title: Name the spec to edit when change approve refuses an unowned affected path
description: Name the spec to edit when change approve refuses an unowned affected path
acceptance_criteria: When change approve refuses an affected path that no declared module owns, the error says which spec to edit for each such path: the undeclared spec that already lists it, or the declared spec to add it to.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-053 keeps deciding ownership at approve; only the refusal wording changes. Leif's t811u rules: never weaken a gate, no em or en dashes in prose.
